title: Why Cloud KMS is a Flawed Architecture: The Rust Argon2id Enclave
threads:
1/5 🔐 InfoSec PSA for builders:

Pasting OpenAI, Anthropic, or X API keys into centralized SaaS dashboards creates a massive single point of failure.

If their cloud KMS is breached, your tokens are compromised 🧵👇

2/5 Zoth Studio runs a native Rust memory daemon (zoth-vault-daemon) on localhost :8787.

• RFC 9106 Argon2id (m=64MB, t=3 passes, p=4 lanes)
• XChaCha20-Poly1305 stream encryption
• Non-swappable volatile RAM (mlock)
3/5 With Rust's ZeroizeOnDrop trait, keys are completely zeroized (0x00) the microsecond they are dropped. Zero plaintext writes to disk.

5/5 Star the repo on GitHub:
https://github.com/NullAITech/zoth-studio
